findings.current: The humiliation of those days when he had no choice but to flatten himself before Cheon Taemin’s gaze and grovel.
findings.defect: The draft changes Michael’s action from lying low to avoid Cheon Taemin’s notice into groveling directly before him.
findings.rationale: 시선을 피해 means avoiding someone’s gaze or notice; the source does not say Michael groveled before Cheon Taemin.
findings.replacement: The humiliation of those days when he had no choice but to keep his head down and stay out of Cheon Taemin’s sight.
findings.source: 천태민의 시선을 피해 납작 엎드릴 수밖에 없었던 그 시절의 굴욕감이.

findings.current: *How dare they. How dare a mere human…*
findings.defect: The draft inserts a plural subject, shifting Leviathan’s anger from the singular human indicated by the following phrase to an unspecified group.
findings.rationale: The first 감히 deliberately omits its object, while 인간 따위가 identifies a singular human in the repeated thought.
findings.replacement: *How dare… How dare a mere human…*

findings.current: That loathsome emotion it had sensed from one impossibly tiny human had bound the mighty monster tightly to the deep sea.
findings.defect: “Sensed from” implies that the fear belonged to or emanated from the human, whereas Leviathan itself felt fear because of that human.
findings.rationale: The preceding standalone 두려움 names Leviathan’s own emotion, and 느꼈던 describes Leviathan experiencing it.
findings.replacement: That loathsome emotion it had felt because of one impossibly tiny human had bound the mighty monster tightly to the deep sea.
findings.source: 한없이 자그마한 어느 인간으로부터 느꼈던 그 혐오스러운 감정이, 이 강대한 괴물을 심해에 꽁꽁 묶어 두고 있었다.

findings.current: Teeth harder than steel shredded the whale and sharks, sucking in thousands of fish.
findings.defect: The participial construction makes the teeth the subject of “sucking in,” obscuring the mechanical sequence in which the teeth tear apart the larger animals and the monster draws in the fish.
findings.rationale: The source coordinates two distinct actions: the teeth cut apart the whale and sharks, then the implied monster sucks in the fish.
findings.replacement: Teeth harder than steel tore the whale and sharks apart, and the monster sucked in thousands of fish.
findings.source: 강철보다 단단한 이빨이 고래와 상어를 토막 내고, 수천 마리의 물고기를 빨아들인다.

findings.current: In the span of little more than a day, Leviathan had absorbed every bit of magical power from the masses that humans called S-rank Magic Gems.
findings.defect: The draft describes extracting magical power from vaguely defined “masses,” rather than absorbing all of the S-rank Magic Gems themselves.
findings.rationale: 모조리 흡수 modifies the objects called S-rank Magic Gems, which are characterized as masses of magical power.
findings.replacement: Over the course of roughly a day, Leviathan had completely absorbed the masses of magical power that humans called S-rank Magic Gems.
findings.source: 하루 남짓한 시간 동안 인간들이 S급 마정석이라 부르는 마력의 덩어리를 모조리 흡수한 레비아탄이다.

findings.current: “You were right, Huginn. That really might happen.”
findings.defect: “Might happen” turns Michael’s concession about Huginn’s observation into a prediction of an event, obscuring that he is acknowledging Huginn may be right about his recent behavior.
findings.rationale: 그럴지도 모르지 refers back to Huginn’s assessment that Michael has been training excessively, especially since learning about Jin Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “You’re right, Huginn. Maybe that really is the case.”
findings.source: “자네 말이 맞네, 후긴. 정말 그럴지도 모르지.”

findings.current: “We will do it. We must. That is my promise.”
findings.defect: The draft adds a separate assertion of obligation that is absent from the prime minister’s statement.
findings.rationale: 반드시 intensifies the certainty of 해내겠다; it does not add a separate “we must” clause.
findings.replacement: “We will do it, no matter what. That is my promise.”

findings.current: [Operator of China’s Biggest Anti–Jin Taekyung Website Arrested by Public Security. Charge: Being a Petty Bastard?]
findings.defect: “Bastard” adds profanity absent from 소인배 and unnecessarily intensifies the headline’s deadpan callback.
findings.rationale: The joke repeats Xiao Yang’s label 소인배 as though it were a criminal charge; it is disparaging but not profane.
findings.replacement: [Operator of China’s Biggest Anti–Jin Taekyung Website Arrested by Public Security. The Charge? Being a Petty Man.]
findings.source: [中 진태경 최대 안티 사이트 운영자, 공안에 의해 긴급 체포. 죄목은 소인배?]

findings.current: “The back of my head suddenly feels hot. Is that just my imagination?”
findings.defect: “Hot” loses the prickling or stinging sensation Michael jokingly attributes to Huginn staring at the back of his head.
findings.rationale: 따갑다 denotes a stinging or prickling sensation rather than warmth, preserving the physical cue behind Michael’s remark.
findings.replacement: “The back of my head suddenly feels prickly. Is that just my imagination?”
findings.source: “갑자기 뒤통수가 따가운 것 같은데, 단순히 기분 탓인가?”

summary: Several passages alter subjects, actions, or mechanisms, most notably Michael’s past response to Cheon Taemin and the source of Leviathan’s fear.
